component.name: Lost Odyssey Recomp
component.summary: Native Xbox 360 static recompilation of Lost Odyssey powered by Vulkan

description.p: Lost Odyssey Recomp is an experimental, native static recompilation project for Lost Odyssey on the Xbox 360, rendering with Vulkan.
Notice: Game data is NOT included. You must legally dump and supply your own legitimate retail game assets.
